comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body:
Shit's an AI video, not something Fable made.

The video deactivates three cores and the behavior for deactivating is different every time. The first is pretty normal, except the percent jumps around. The second starts deactivation from 15 feet away and moving around, the third is instant.

And that's ignoring the funny ammo counts in the bottom right when he's shooting. Like firing four shots and going from 22 to 10. Or the very much AI text goofiness when the count changes. Or how the first reload just resets the count to 30, but a later reload empties it to 0 before resetting it.
